labels.look: White, headline/lead/body text set twice, a vertical wipe line splitting 'Without' vs 'With optical sizing'
labels.ux: Drag the split line to compare the same text with and without opsz
labels.learn: A wipe slider over identical text exposes a subtle axis (optical size) that side-by-side columns would hide

labels.variantDefinition: A short teaser paragraph and button sending readers to an off-page article, blog post or interview about the making of the font
labels.look: Orange/green/yellow geometric tiles built from glyph shapes, big concentric circles, white CJK headline; sticky nav overlaps
labels.ux: Button links to the designers' process blog post
labels.learn: Frame the process write-up as a 'secret recipe' question to make a long read feel like a treat

labels.look: Cream page, centred serif text, licence-tier dropdown, large price 'Eur 23,-', EULA checkbox
labels.ux: Pick licence size, price updates, tick EULA to reveal a PayPal checkout link
labels.learn: Gating the pay link behind an EULA tick keeps a one-person shop legally tidy with zero infrastructure

labels.look: Full-width vintage travel-label illustration: 'VILLA & RISTORANTE «GROSSETO»' over a red hotel and pink sky
labels.learn: Period-correct illustration (hotel luggage labels) places a revival font back in its original habitat

labels.variantDefinition: One editable sample (or set of samples) driven by a single shared toolbar: size, weight/axis slider, alignment
labels.look: White, huge black ultra-heavy paragraph, thin toolbar: Edit sample, 1979-2050 slider, alignment, 60px menu
labels.ux: Editable text; slider scrubs years (weight = sea-ice extent); alignment radios; size select
labels.learn: Label the weight axis with what it encodes (years of ice melt): the slider becomes the message

labels.variantDefinition: Cards or a list linking to the designer's or foundry's other typefaces or projects, cross-promotion near the page end
labels.look: Charcoal field, 'Explore additional projects.', two image cards (glyph with metrics, blue diamond shapes) with captions; fixed bars repeated by capture
labels.ux: Click a card to visit another project
labels.learn: Ending a microsite with sibling projects keeps visitors inside the designer's world instead of bouncing

labels.look: Teal page, card with risograph print photo, script-heading 'Personal License' / 'Commercial License', then newsletter form and thanks
labels.ux: One 'Get Escafina' card links to the foundry shop; newsletter signup below
labels.learn: Pay-what-you-want personal licence plus a physical print bonus on the commercial one makes buying feel like patronage

labels.look: Cobalt blue, all text in the dotted/striped display font: Design, Release, Photography, Styles, Formats, Character set; orange marquee bar
labels.ux: Links to photographer and distributor; free-trial tab
labels.learn: Set the colophon's label-value pairs in the display face itself: the facts sheet doubles as a last specimen

labels.variantDefinition: A run of images documenting the making (sketches, printed proofs, editor screenshots, outline close-ups), with little or no text
labels.look: Full-width extreme close-up of green outline curves (a magnified letterform), black nav bar across; one image of a process series
labels.ux: static; images fade in on scroll
labels.learn: Magnify a single curve until it becomes abstract art: shows care at the outline level
